data.title: PR-20 IMPL-03: exact replay gates (base_replay, exact_regression) for repair transactions

data.body: [HIGH] Gate 4 can pass after relaxing the recorded execution without any declared policy. Any Ran result with no failure becomes NoLongerFails, regardless of nonzero eliminated or reordered counts. Lines 952-960 then persist Passed. The committed test at crates/continuum-repair/tests/pr20_impl03_exact_replay.rs:222-246 proves this with eliminated=3 and reordered=1. The M01 golden records 400/400 passes while four steps are eliminated and 3-6 are reordered. RFC 0032:159 requires continuation under the transaction evaluation_policy. It forbids passing by declaring divergence uninteresting. This transaction carries no policy, as replay.rs:103-108 admits. An untrusted repair can remove or move causal events until the failure disappears, then receive passed exact_regression evidence. Fail closed unless an identity-bound policy authorizes the correspondence. Otherwise return Diverged or inconclusive. Failure modes: false passed evidence can support an invalid repair. Edge cases: zero eliminated and zero reordered remains valid; any nonzero value needs policy. Rollback: revert this pass rule and retain new content identities for re-derived artifacts. Monitoring: alert on Passed exact_regression with nonzero eliminated or reordered counts, or no bound policy. Validation: add negative removed-event and reordered-only cases, plus a positive case with a bound policy and independent replay.

[MEDIUM] Unsupported outcomes are persisted without their typed reason or a replayer-bound evidence record. Base Unsupported and candidate Unsupported both call cite(None), so the transaction cites only the crashpack. The committed test at crates/continuum-repair/tests/pr20_impl03_exact_replay.rs:690-717 confirms this. The M01 golden at lines 47-53 also has no ev_ or defect_ record. The persisted artifact therefore loses Replayer::identity and InconclusiveReason::Unsupported. RFC 0032:178 requires an inconclusive gate to carry its typed reason. A later verifier cannot distinguish unsupported semantics from another cause or recheck which replayer produced it. Emit an evidence record that binds gate, program, crashpack, replayer, and Unsupported. Persist the typed reason through the transaction evidence model.

data.reason: [HIGH] exact_regression passes eliminated or reordered executions without a declared evaluation policy (th-3gvjvn). Unsupported outcomes also lose typed reason and replayer-bound evidence (th-2ahegk). The separate risk:critical human-approval gate remains required.

data.body: Fixed in 87839a7d. replay::evaluate now takes an EvaluationPolicy and records its token as the version's evaluation_policy (part of the rt_ identity) and in every ev_/defect_ record. Under the fail-closed EvaluationPolicy::Exact, a clean candidate run with any eliminated or reordered step is ExactRegression::NotExact: inconclusive, AbstractionAmbiguity, never passed. Only a declared ContinueAndDisclose admits it, and the ev_ record lists the eliminated positions and the reordered count. Recurs and FailsDifferently still fail under either policy. Tests: continuum-repair pr20_impl03_negative_an_eliminated_or_reordered_candidate_run_is_refused_under_exact (eliminated, reordered-only, both: all inconclusive under Exact; the same runs pass only under ContinueAndDisclose, with a different rt_ identity). continuum-asupersync pr20_impl03_the_exact_policy_refuses_an_eliminated_or_reordered_run: M01 ack-after-sync under Exact is NotExact on 400/400 runs; the golden pins both policies (pos-01 and neg-04). Who may declare ContinueAndDisclose is left to the policy verdict and RFC 0032 correction bn-2vanm.

Fixed in 87839a7d. BaseReplay::Unsupported and ExactRegression::Unsupported now carry an ev_ record, and the gate cites [crash_, ev_]. Every record, not only Unsupported ones, binds the gate, crashpack, program, Replayer::identity, evaluation policy, gate status and the typed INV-008 reason token (InconclusiveReason::as_str; empty for passed and failed), plus the answer discriminant (2 = Unsupported). The reason lives in the cited record because the schema's gate entry has no field for it. Tests: continuum-repair pr20_impl03_boundary_an_unsupported_program_is_inconclusive checks both gates cite a record named by its bytes and holding the gate, crashpack, program, replayer 'scripted/1', policy, 'inconclusive' and 'Unsupported'. continuum-asupersync pr20_impl03_a_divergence_is_inconclusive checks the register replayer's identity, 'Unsupported' and the policy in the candidate's Unsupported record.

[RESOLVED] The target now gives Unsupported outcomes an ev_ record and cites it beside the crashpack. crates/continuum-repair/src/replay.rs:992-1001 and 1074-1082 bind the gate, program, replayer, policy, inconclusive status, and Unsupported reason through the canonical record at lines 1165-1216.

data.reason: Target 87839a7d carries and cites typed Unsupported evidence.

data.body: [HIGH] ContinueAndDisclose remains an unauthorised pass switch. evaluate accepts this caller-selected enum at crates/continuum-repair/src/replay.rs:876-883, and lines 1012-1016 pass a clean non-exact run solely because that value was supplied. The artifact only records its token at crates/continuum-repair/src/transaction.rs:899-904. It carries no identity-bound policy decision or authority, and Replayer::identity is also self-declared. An untrusted caller can therefore select the relaxed branch and mint passed exact_regression evidence after eliminating or reordering causal steps. Fail closed until an independently resolved policy artifact authorizes this transaction and correspondence. Otherwise keep non-exact runs inconclusive. Failure modes: a causal-event-removing repair gets false passed evidence. Edge cases: exact runs remain valid; unknown, stale, mismatched, or unauthorized policies must not pass. Rollback: remove the relaxed pass arm and retain Exact behavior. Monitoring: alert on passed exact_regression with ContinueAndDisclose, nonzero eliminated/reordered counts, or no verified policy identity. Validation: add negative caller-selected, unknown, stale, and mismatched policy tests, plus one positive test using an independently verified transaction-bound authorization.

data.reason: HIGH th-2f0edh: caller-selected ContinueAndDisclose can pass non-exact replay without an independently verified, transaction-bound policy authorization.

data.body: Fixed in 40b5f41b. The caller can no longer choose the policy. replay::evaluate takes Option<&PolicyAuthorization>, and None means EvaluationPolicy::Exact. ContinueAndDisclose is reachable only through a PolicyAuthorization bound to the version's rt_ identity (so a superseded version's authorization is stale), its base and candidate snapshots, and its base intent (the in_ content identity of the protected contract), with a digest over those fields and the policy. evaluate checks every field and the digest against the transaction before any replay. A mismatch is ExactReplayRefusal::Authorization(Policy|Transaction|BaseSnapshot|CandidateSnapshot|Intent|Digest), never a fallback to a pass. Nothing in production issues one: the constructor is crate-private and #[cfg(test)], a compile_fail doctest shows it cannot be built outside the crate, and the public seam request_continue_and_disclose answers AuthorizationAbsence::NoAuthority (owners bn-2vanm, bn-b6u4; stated in the module docs, START_HERE and the review record). The recorded evaluation_policy keeps the policy token in the rt_ identity, and when authorized it is '<token>;authorization=<digest>', also written into every ev_/defect_ record. Tests (crate unit tests, the only path that can mint): an_authorization_bound_to_the_version_admits_continue_and_disclose; without_an_authorization_the_policy_is_exact_and_the_run_is_not_passed (also checks the seam answers NoAuthority); an_authorization_for_another_transaction_snapshot_or_intent_is_refused (another version, another intent, and each bound field altered alone); a_stale_or_tampered_authorization_is_refused (superseded version, a forged digest, a tampered digest). The M01 golden is now Exact only: the ack-after-sync candidate does not fail, but gate 4 is inconclusive not-exact on 400/400 runs and is never passed.

[RESOLVED][HIGH] The target now defaults to Exact at crates/continuum-repair/src/replay.rs:1083-1087. A clean non-exact run becomes NotExact at lines 1189-1218. ContinueAndDisclose requires checked authorization at lines 1088-1100. Production issues none at lines 755-760. The M01 artifacts now record gate 4 as inconclusive. No blocker remains.

data.reason: Fixed at target 40b5f41b: non-exact runs fail closed without authorization.

data.body: [RESOLVED][HIGH] The public caller no longer selects EvaluationPolicy. evaluate accepts only Option<&PolicyAuthorization> at crates/continuum-repair/src/replay.rs:1034-1041. The type has private fields, its issuer is test-only at lines 779-795, and production returns NoAuthority at lines 755-760. Lines 820-845 check policy, version, snapshots, intent, and digest before replay. Missing authorization selects Exact. No production bypass remains.

data.reason: Fixed at target 40b5f41b: relaxed evaluation has no production issuer and checked binding.

[INFO][risk:high][NO FINDINGS] Full persisted range 3c35e49b399229e1227227cd96250ef28d381c56..40b5f41b49da322c28a05e9d2fdd2940c482a72e reviewed.

Failure modes: crashpack, base, or candidate substitution; false passage after eliminated or reordered steps; divergence laundering; lost typed reasons; unauthorized relaxed policy; or admission of a dishonest replayer. Identity checks at crates/continuum-repair/src/replay.rs:1054-1081 refuse substituted artifacts. Lines 1083-1101 select only Exact or a checked authorization. Lines 1189-1260 keep non-exact, divergent, and unsupported runs from passing.

Edge cases: malformed, foreign, and trailing crashpack bytes; absent, different, or inconsistent failures; eliminated and reordered steps; wrong content; duplicate evaluation; unsupported semantics; and mismatched or tampered authorization. Outcome evidence binds gate, crashpack, program, replayer, policy, status, typed reason, and answer at replay.rs:1335-1395.

Rollback: revert the three feature commits d3eb75a0, 87839a7d, and 40b5f41b before daemon integration. This range changes no served operation, schema document, or published production state.

Monitoring: count every replay refusal, failed or inconclusive gate, missing cited record, and unadmitted replayer identity. Alert on any passed exact_regression with nonzero eliminated or reordered counts, a non-Exact policy without verified authority, or evidence-publication failure.

Validation: static review covered all 21 changed files and the supporting identity, transaction, replay, register, schema, receipt, governance, and audit paths. git diff --check passed. The read-only TCB audit passed. No Rust tests ran under this metadata-only reviewer contract. No security blocker remains. This LGTM does not satisfy or bypass the separate risk:critical human-approval gate.
